# FreeToolHub
> 81+ free browser-based online tools for developers, students, and professionals. No login, no data collection, works offline.

FreeToolHub (https://freetoolhub.app) is a free tool website with 81+ utilities that run entirely in the browser using JavaScript. No signup, no login, no server — all processing happens locally on the user's device.

## Key Facts
- 81+ free tools
- Zero login or signup required
- All tools run 100% in the browser
- No data is ever uploaded to any server
- Works offline after first load
- Free forever

## Tool Categories

### Developer Tools (19 tools)
JSON Formatter, JSON Validator, JSON Minifier, JSON to CSV, JSON to XML, JSON Diff, XML Formatter, YAML to JSON, SQL Formatter, Base64 Encode/Decode, URL Encode/Decode, UUID Generator, Regex Tester, JWT Decoder, Hash Generator, Unix Timestamp Converter, Color Converter, HTML Escape/Unescape, Markdown Preview

### Text Tools (18 tools)
Word Counter, Character Counter, Case Converter, Remove Duplicate Lines, Sort Lines, Reverse Text, Find & Replace, Remove Blank Lines, Text Cleaner, CSV to JSON, JSON to CSV, Word Frequency, Reading Time, Text Splitter, Remove Emojis, Email Extractor, URL Extractor, Phone Extractor

### Everyday Tools (10 tools)
Password Generator, Lorem Ipsum, Random Number, Age Calculator, Percentage Calculator, Unit Converter, Date Calculator, Stopwatch, Countdown Timer, Pomodoro Timer

### Finance Tools (13 tools)
EMI Calculator, SIP Calculator, FD Calculator, RD Calculator, Compound Interest, Simple Interest, GST Calculator, Discount Calculator, ROI Calculator, CAGR Calculator, Break-even Calculator, Margin Calculator, Salary Converter

### Student Tools (5 tools)
CGPA Calculator, GPA Calculator, CGPA to Percentage, Attendance Calculator, Marks/Grade Calculator

### SEO & Web Tools (10 tools)
Meta Tag Generator, Open Graph Generator, Twitter Card Generator, Robots.txt Generator, Slug Generator, UTM Builder, Keyword Density, FAQ Schema, Article Schema, Product Schema

### Image Tools (6 tools)
Image Resizer, Image Compressor, Image Format Converter, Rotate & Flip, Grayscale & Filters, Image to Base64
